reference.source: training notebook, full lesion-grouped test set (2,014 images), prior correction alpha = 0.3

T1.name: Clinical accuracy (laboratory)
T1.criterion: Full test set (2,014 images): accuracy within 1.5 percentage points of 85.80%. 300-image sample: the 95% confidence interval is reported instead (no pass/fail).

T2.name: Integration agreement
T2.criterion: At least 99% of test images get the identical predicted class from the app and from test_predictions.npz (y_pred_corrected); the largest probability difference is reported.

T3.name: Robustness to photo conditions
T3.criterion: On 200 test images, the average share of predictions unchanged by the 8 conditions is at least 85% (every condition is reported separately).

T4.name: Speed
T4.criterion: 95th percentile of prediction + Grad-CAM time under 30 seconds on this laptop (50 images; all stages reported).

T5.name: Reliability and load
T5.criterion: 100 analyses in a row and 5 simultaneous users through the real HTTP API: 0 crashes and 0 failed requests.

T6.name: Photo quality check
T6.criterion: At least 90% of the degraded images in each group (blurred, dark, tiny, non-skin) get the matching warning. Set by the team before the first run; warnings on unchanged test images are reported for information.

T7.name: Functional and security tests
T7.criterion: The complete automated test suite passes (0 failures, 0 errors).

model.name: SkinLens hybrid (EfficientNetV2-S + Swin V2 + metadata) + prior correction (alpha=0.3)

confidence_levels.description: High > 80%, Medium 50-80%, Low < 50% (of the corrected top-class probability)
